trigger.description: The workspace search index is healthy (IndexHealth::Ready) and a confirmed semantic embedder is active, but a non-empty corpus has zero embedded vectors. Retrieval therefore uses only the lexical arm and under-recalls paraphrases and synonyms. The status search row is degraded_recoverable; index storage health remains ready and doctor keeps semantic capability advisory. A rebuild embeds the corpus. The fixture requires a ready lexical index with semantic=true and vector_coverage={embedded:0,total:3}; ready_index_and_workspace_status_agree_on_semantic_degradations constructs this state deterministically without downloads. There is no portable CLI-only setup for this incomplete-vector state. Missing-model hash fallback is instead reported as embed_model_unavailable and requires restoring or fetching the model first. Pending or unconfirmed probes emit neither code.
